name: Agrasen Ki Baoli
description: Dramatic 60-meter stepwell from Mahabharata era. 103 steps descending into darkness. Featured in PK movie.

name: Akshardham Temple
description: Sprawling modern Hindu temple complex with boat ride, water show, exhibitions, and stunning architecture.

name: Chandni Chowk
description: Asia's oldest and busiest market street (1650). Paranthas, jalebi, spices, electronics, and old Delhi charm.

name: Dilli Haat
description: Open-air food and craft bazaar with stalls from all Indian states. Government-run, fixed prices. Great for souvenirs.

name: Gurudwara Bangla Sahib
description: Iconic Sikh gurudwara with golden dome and sacred sarovar. 24/7 langar feeds thousands daily.

name: Hauz Khas Village
description: Historic ruins meets trendy restaurants and boutiques. 13th-century madrasa and reservoir with deer park.

name: Hazrat Nizamuddin Dargah
description: Sufi shrine of the 14th-century saint. Thursday evening qawwali sessions are a transcendent experience.

name: Humayun's Tomb
description: UNESCO World Heritage Mughal garden tomb (1570). Precursor to the Taj Mahal in architecture and design.

name: India Gate & Kartavya Path
description: 42-meter war memorial designed by Lutyens. Amar Jawan Jyoti eternal flame. Iconic Delhi landmark.

name: Jama Masjid
description: India's largest mosque built by Shah Jahan in 1656. Can hold 25,000 worshippers. Climb minaret for views.

name: Jantar Mantar
description: Astronomical observation site built by Maharaja Jai Singh II in 1724 with 13 architectural instruments.

name: Lodhi Gardens
description: Historic park with 15th-century Sayyid and Lodhi dynasty tombs. Popular jogging and picnic spot.

name: Lotus Temple
description: Bahai House of Worship shaped like a lotus flower. 27 marble petals. Open to all faiths for prayer.

name: National Gallery of Modern Art
description: India's leading modern art museum with works by Amrita Sher-Gil, Rabindranath Tagore, and contemporary artists.

name: National Museum
description: India's largest museum with 200,000 works spanning 5,000 years. Indus Valley artifacts to modern art.

name: Purana Qila (Old Fort)
description: One of the oldest forts in Delhi built on the site of ancient Indraprastha. Mughal architecture with sound-light show.

name: Qutub Minar
description: UNESCO World Heritage 73-meter tower built in 1193. Tallest brick minaret in the world with Indo-Islamic carvings.

name: Raj Ghat
description: Mahatma Gandhi's cremation site. Simple black marble platform with eternal flame in serene gardens.

name: Red Fort (Lal Qila)
description: UNESCO World Heritage Mughal fort built by Shah Jahan in 1638. Sound and light show every evening.

name: Netarhat Sunrise Point
description: Called "Queen of Chotanagpur". Famous sunrise and sunset points at 3,700 ft. Sal forests and waterfalls.

name: Prabhat Vihar (Sunrise Point)
description: Best sunrise viewpoint in Netarhat at 1,128m. Watch mist clear from Chotanagpur plateau at dawn.

name: Upper Ghaghri Falls
description: Cascading waterfall 4km from Netarhat. Swimming pool at base. Monsoon surge impressive.

name: Upper Ghagri Falls
description: Waterfall cascading through dense forest near Netarhat. Accessible via forest trail.

name: Chail Cricket Ground
description: World's highest cricket ground at 7,500 ft, built in 1893 by Maharaja of Patiala.

name: Chail Palace
description: Former summer retreat of Maharaja of Patiala, now a heritage hotel surrounded by deodar forests.

name: Kali Ka Tibba
description: Hilltop temple at the highest point in Chail with 360-degree views of Shimla and Kasauli.

name: Christ Church Kasauli
description: Anglican church built in 1853, one of the oldest churches in North India. Beautiful stained glass.

name: Kasauli Mall Road
description: Colonial-era main street with heritage buildings, cafés, and craft shops surrounded by pine forests.

name: Monkey Point
description: Highest point in Kasauli at 6,130 ft with a temple and views stretching to Chandigarh plains. Army area.

name: Allahabad Fort
description: Mughal fort built by Akbar in 1583 at the confluence. Houses the Akshaya Vat (undying banyan tree) and Patalpuri Temple.

name: Anand Bhawan
description: Ancestral home of the Nehru-Gandhi family. Museum with personal belongings, letters, and independence movement artifacts.

name: Triveni Sangam
description: Sacred confluence of Ganges, Yamuna, and mythical Saraswati. Site of the world's largest gathering — Kumbh Mela.

name: Bala Quila Fort
description: Massive hilltop fort predating Amber Fort. 5 km perimeter wall with views of Alwar city and lakes.

name: Sariska Tiger Reserve
description: Tiger reserve in the Aravallis. Home to Bengal tigers, leopards, and the Pandupol Hanuman temple.

name: Devka Beach
description: Beach with amusement park, water rides, and camel rides. Most developed beach in Daman for families.

name: Moti Daman Fort
description: Larger Portuguese fort with Church of Bom Jesus, lighthouse, and seafront bastions overlooking the Arabian Sea.

name: Bering Nag Temple
description: Ancient pagoda-style temple in Batseri village with elaborate wood carvings and stone reliefs.

name: Kinnaur Kailash
description: Sacred 19,849 ft peak with a natural rock Shiva lingam at the summit. Circumambulation pilgrimage in August.

name: Morni Fort Ruins
description: Ruins of an ancient fort at the highest point in Haryana. Trek through pine forests.

name: Tikkar Taal
description: Twin lakes in the Shivalik foothills. Boating, bird watching, and forested surroundings.

name: Batseri Village
description: Traditional Kinnauri village known for weaving and wood carving. Authentic homestay experience.

name: Kamru Fort
description: Ancient hilltop fort with Kamaksha Devi temple. Blend of Hindu and Buddhist architecture with wood carvings.

name: Surya Kund
description: Hot spring near the temple where water boils. Pilgrims cook rice and potatoes in the thermal water.

name: Yamunotri Temple
description: Char Dham temple dedicated to Goddess Yamuna at 10,797 ft. Accessible only by a 6 km trek.

name: Kodia Jungle Trek
description: Dense forest trail through oak and deodar trees with rope courses and adventure activities.

name: Jalmandir (Water Temple)
description: White marble Jain temple in the middle of a lotus tank. Marks the cremation site of Lord Mahavira.

name: Blackbuck Safari Drive
description: Open grassland jeep safari. Herds of 100+ blackbuck visible. Wolves, hyenas, and harrier birds in winter.
